_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. See lib/models/father_week_derive.dart. Adding one of those keys here overrides the derivation for that section only.

title.en: Feeling stupid is part of it
title.hi: बेवक़ूफ़ लगना इसी का हिस्सा है

body.en: Talking to a bump feels ridiculous the first time. Every father who does it felt that. Do it badly for a week and it stops feeling like a performance.
body.hi: पहली बार पेट से बात करना अजीब लगता है। हर उस पिता को यही लगा है जो यह करता है। एक हफ़्ता ख़राब तरीक़े से कीजिए, फिर यह दिखावा लगना बंद हो जाएगा।
